title: Brazilian Pudding Parfait
description: A layered dessert with Brazilian flavors, featuring sweet and creamy elements.
instructions: In a small bowl, whip the naturally sweetened whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
In a separate bowl, mix the pudding and Brazilian sweetened condensed milk.
In a parfait glass or tall clear cup, create a layer of the whipped cream.
Top the whipped cream with a layer of the pudding mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with the whipped cream on top.
Sprinkle crumbled feta cheese on top of the whipped cream.
Garnish with fresh berries and a sprinkle of cocoa powder, if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
